'''Michael Krivelevich''' ([[Hebrew language|Hebrew]]: 'מיכאל קריבלביץ; born January 30, 1966) is a professor with the School of Mathematical Sciences of [[Tel Aviv University]], [[Israel]].

Krivelevich received his PhD from Tel Aviv University in 1997 under the supervision of [[Noga Alon]]. He has published extensively in [[combinatorics]] and adjacent fields and specializes in [[extremal combinatorics|extremal]] and [[probabilistic combinatorics]].<ref>{{cite book | author = N. Alon and M. Krivelevich | url = http://www.math.tau.ac.il/~nogaa/PDFS/epc7.pdf | chapter = Extremal and Probabilistic Combinatorics | editor = W. T. Gowers | publisher = Princeton University Press | year = 2008 | title = Princeton Companion to Mathematics | pages = 562–575}}</ref>

He serves as an editor-in-chief of the [[Journal of Combinatorial Theory]] (Series B) and is on the editorial board of several other journals in the field.

==Awards and honors==
In 2007, Krivelevich and [[Alan Frieze]] won the Pazy Memorial Award for research into probabilistic reasoning in combinatorics.<ref>{{cite web | author = U.S.-Israel Binational Science Foundation | title = Pazy Award, list of recipients | url = http://www.bsf.org.il/bsfpublic/DefaultPage1.aspx?PageId=331&innerTextID=331}}</ref>

In 2014, Krivelevich gave an invited address in the Combinatorics section at the [[List of International Congresses of Mathematicians Plenary and Invited Speakers|International Congress of Mathematicians]].<ref>[http://www.icm2014.org/en/participants/abstracts/guidelines ICM 2014 Scientific Program] {{webarchive|url=https://web.archive.org/web/20140925095002/http://www.icm2014.org/en/participants/abstracts/guidelines |date=2014-09-25 }}</ref>

He was elected as a member of the 2017 class of [[Fellow]]s of the [[American Mathematical Society]] "for contributions to extremal and probabilistic combinatorics".<ref>[https://www.ams.org/profession/ams-fellows/new-fellows 2017 Class of the Fellows of the AMS], [[American Mathematical Society]], retrieved 2016-11-06.</ref>
